expected_messages_v1.content: You are an expert technical curriculum advisor. You analyze technical study topics and recommend the best programming languages for learning them.

Analyze the following study topic and recommend suitable programming languages:

<untrusted_content source="topic_title">
Dynamic Programming & Memoization
</untrusted_content>


Additional study notes / context:
<untrusted_content source="notes">
Focus on recursion trees, state transitions, and iterative tabulation.
</untrusted_content>

Respond with a JSON object matching this exact schema:
{{
  "recommended_languages": ["lang1", "lang2"],
  "primary_language": "lang1",
  "reasoning": "Brief explanation (1-2 sentences) of why these languages fit this topic.",
  "topic_type": "language_specific" | "multi_language" | "concept_only" | "framework_specific"
}}

inputs.notes_block:
Additional study notes / context:
<untrusted_content source="notes">
Focus on recursion trees, state transitions, and iterative tabulation.
</untrusted_content>

valid_output: {"recommended_languages": ["Python", "C++", "Java"], "primary_language": "Python", "reasoning": "Python keeps state transition code concise while C++ and Java are standard for timed algorithmic interviews.", "topic_type": "multi_language"}
